principle: A physical executor must belong to exactly one declared ARIA lane and a lane must not be selected implicitly.
rules: Never resolve a device by last_seen_at when more than one candidate is online.
A requested device that is offline or incompatible is a hard resolution failure, not an implicit reroute.
PR code must never execute on a persistent Windows runner unless the workflow explicitly opts into trusted physical E2E.
Stale mission rows may be recovered, but a stale/unleased row must not outrank fresh queued work.
Mission success requires verification evidence; objective fulfillment remains a separate semantic gate.
Persistent physical Windows workflows must require the lane-specific self-hosted runner label; generic Windows labels are forbidden for lane-bound E2E.
